outcome: Professor review can now resolve false-positive capability requests as Already Supported
owner_impact: Already Supported is now a sixth Professor response, distinct from Reject and distinct from request lifecycle. It closes an erroneous missing-capability request as resolved and records exactly which deployed canonical capabilities or stable contract paths satisfy it. The five known false-positive Eliseo requests are reconciled through that mechanism; the genuine neighbour-visible scalar request and explicitly requested coloured-region feature remain pending.

next.text: Issue #524 is the known successor and has not started yet. It will change closure analysis so already-supported paper/Experiment requirements are recorded directly as support evidence before request creation, making this sixth response an exceptional recovery path rather than routine cleanup.

technical_evidence: Request status gains terminal resolved while Professor disposition gains already_supported; the two axes remain constrained separately.
